title: OpenAI Launches New Computer History Feature, Enabling Users to Remember Operations Without Taking Screenshots

content_html:
OpenAI has recently announced a new optional feature called "Computer History" for ChatGPT Work and Codex users on macOS. This feature is primarily available to Pro, Business, and Enterprise subscribers. After obtaining user authorization, it can track daily computer activities across applications and websites and automatically convert them into structured memories and timelines.

In practical applications, this feature will significantly enhance ChatGPT's contextual understanding and retrieval capabilities. Users no longer need to spend time re-explaining background information to the AI. Instead, they can simply ask questions like "What was I debugging yesterday?" or "Where did I leave off on that PR?" and ChatGPT will accurately locate relevant files, documents, and conversations in Google Docs, Slack, or browser tabs based on the history of operations. For situations where users vaguely remember reading a document but completely forget its exact location, this feature offers great convenience.

Differing from Microsoft's controversial Recall feature, which uses continuous screenshot mechanisms, OpenAI emphasized that this feature does not take screenshots during operation. The development team stated that "Computer History" does not rely on screen visuals or audio capture, but instead efficiently generates memories by tracking interaction events such as clicks, typing, and application switching. This also distinguishes it from OpenAI's early Chronicle research project and Record & Replay features.

In terms of privacy protection and user control, the feature is default off and users can pause it at any time through the macOS menu bar or desktop settings, or freely exclude specific applications and websites from access. All collected activity data is stored locally, and users can view the captured content anytime and delete any information they do not wish to retain.

Currently, the "Computer History" feature is being rolled out to applicable subscribers worldwide, although users in the European Economic Area (EEA), the UK, and Switzerland are expected to gain access within the next few weeks.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 最近为 macOS 上的 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 用户宣布了一项名为“计算机历史记录”的新可选功能。 此功能主要适用于专业版、商业版和企业版订阅者。 在获得用户授权后，它可以跨应用程序和网站跟踪日常计算机活动，并自动将其转换为结构化记忆和时间线。

在实际应用中，该功能将显着增强ChatGPT的上下文理解和检索能力。 用户不再需要花时间向人工智能重新解释背景信息。 相反，他们可以简单地提出诸如“我昨天调试了什么？”之类的问题。 或者“我在公关上哪里停了下来？” ChatGPT 将根据操作历史记录准确定位 Google Docs、Slack 或浏览器选项卡中的相关文件、文档和对话。 对于用户隐约记得读过文档但完全忘记其具体位置的情况，此功能提供了极大的便利。

与微软备受争议的Recall功能采用连续截图机制不同，OpenAI强调该功能在操作过程中不会进行截图。 开发团队表示，《电脑历史》不依赖屏幕视觉或音频捕捉，而是通过跟踪点击、打字、应用程序切换等交互事件来高效生成记忆。 这也将其与 OpenAI 早期的 Chronicle 研究项目和 Record & Replay 功能区分开来。

在隐私保护和用户控制方面，该功能默认关闭，用户可以通过macOS菜单栏或桌面设置随时暂停该功能，或者自由排除特定应用程序和网站的访问。 所有收集的活动数据都存储在本地，用户可以随时查看捕获的内容并删除任何他们不希望保留的信息。

目前，“计算机历史记录”功能正在向全球适用的订户推出，但欧洲经济区 (EEA)、英国和瑞士的用户预计将在未来几周内获得访问权限。
